mechanism: Calcium carbonate reduces hydrochlorothiazide absorption through chelation and pH elevation in the GI tract, while thiazide diuretics increase urinary calcium excretion and serum calcium levels, creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours (calcium carbonate before HCTZ) and monitor serum calcium levels periodically; consider alternative antihypertensive if hypercalcemia or hypocalcemia develops.
